newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lum Chang expects better full year.
newsitem.headline: Lum Chang expects better full year.

text.p: Construction and property-based Lum Chang Holdings Ltd said on Thursday the group expected better results in the financial year ending June.
In a statement accompanying its interim earnings, Lum Chang said it expected to complete some profitable construction contracts in the second half of the financial year.
Contributions from its properties, hotels and stockbroking divisions would also add to profits, it said.
An extraordinary gain of about S$21 million had been realised mainly from the divestment of its interest in Solarvest Sdn Bhd, which was completed on January 22 1997, it said.
Lum Chang's net profit rose 190 percent to S$8.9 million for the half year ended December 31, 1996 while turnover rose 44 percent to S$146.69 million.
It said the higher profits were due mainly to gains recognised from the progressive completion of its Emerald Green condomimium project in Singapore.
